spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the main Hawaiian Islands from Kauai in the northwest to the large island in the southeast over dark ocean. Scattered white cumulus, stratocumulus and cirrus clouds are present across the scene, with heavier white cloud cover over the windward sides of the islands and over much of the large southeastern island including the summit area, obscuring any distinct gray haze or streak. No thin gray plume distinct from ordinary white clouds is clearly visible.

classify.caveats: No plume found; nothing to classify.

kilauea.activity_summary: Glow, flames, and minor spattering over the past day; no additional eruptive activity. Kīlauea's summit remains at a high level of pressurization with changes in eruptive activity or location within the summit region possible.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
